modules.module_title: Carrying out preparatory activities to weighing of dyes and chemicals

pcs.pc_description: understand the task mentioned in the job order received for dyeing.
understand msds ( material safety data sheet) as applicable to dyes and chemicals.
use proper ppe like hand gloves and nose mask etc as applicable.
ensure the workplace is well lit and ventilated.
ensure weighing machine with correct resolution is used.
ensure that all weighing scale are calibrated and clean.
where mixers are used, ensure they are clean.
ensure suitable spoon/spatula is used for handling of dyes and chemicals.
check that previously mixed dyes / chemicals are dispensed and dyeing tank is clean.

modules.module_title: Activities related to weighing of Dyes & Chemical

pcs.pc_description: check the zero setting of weighing balance.
read & understand the dyestuff and chemicals to be weighed.
use correct spoon, spatula and/or correct carrier to pick dyes & chemicals.
check the quantity of dyestuff to be weighed.
weigh all dyestuff separately.
weigh all the chemicals separately.
weigh the bigger quantity first & smaller in the last.
use non-sticky papers for weighing of dyes.
weigh smaller quantity (less than 20 gm ) on precision balance.
clean the weighing pan after every use.
check and reconfirm the total weight.

modules.module_title: Reporting and Recording of Inspection Results

pcs.pc_description: where applicable create batch for dyes and chemicals with suitable lot indication.
record details of batch in log book.

modules.module_title: Dossolving & Dispensing of Dyestuff and Chemicals

pcs.pc_description: take a little amount of water with/without a small amount of wetting agent.
add first a small amount of dyestuff and make paste.
dilute with required amount of water and dilute while stirring continuously.
add amount of chemicals and auxiliaries and stir to mix well.
take the required quantity of water in tank.
heat it up to the specified mixing temp.
pour the solution prepared with weighed dyestuff, chemicals & auxiliaries slowly into the tank while stirring.
avoid dusting or splashing of dyes & chemicals while preparing solution.
dispense the solution of dissolved dyes with chemicals & auxiliaries to the machine tanks at regular intervals at defined installment.
flush the line after every dispensing.
